summary.narrative: Inspection identified 16 verified checks. 1 require immediate remediation to prevent lead leakage, 12 affect conversion consistency or search visibility, and 0 passed technical standards.

revenueImpact.title: LEAD & REVENUE LEAKAGE DETECTED
revenueImpact.description: Dead CTA buttons (action keywords with # anchor): Frustrated prospects bounce immediately; zero lead capture.

customerJourneys.name: Journey A — New Visitor
customerJourneys.notes: Evaluates value proposition clarity and whether visitor finds primary CTA without friction.

customerJourneys.name: Journey B — Inquiring Lead
customerJourneys.flow: Homepage → Contact Form / Phone → Submission → Notification
customerJourneys.notes: Tests whether prospect can reach the business via form, click-to-call, or email.

customerJourneys.name: Journey C — Mobile Customer
customerJourneys.flow: 320px Mobile Screen → Touch CTA → Dial / Chat Conversion
customerJourneys.notes: Verifies tap-to-call dialers and mobile layouts at compact 320px viewport.

customerJourneys.name: Journey D — Returning User
customerJourneys.flow: Direct URL → Cached State → Fast Navigation
customerJourneys.notes: Validates browser caching, compression, and rapid page reloads for returning customers.

customerJourneys.name: Journey E — Failure Recovery
customerJourneys.flow: Input Error / Non-existent Route → Helpful Guidance → Retry
customerJourneys.notes: Checks authentic 404 status handling and recovery options when errors occur.

issues.title: Legacy image formats used instead of WebP/AVIF
issues.evidence: 15 images served as uncompressed PNG/JPEG assets.
issues.userImpact: High mobile data consumption; sluggish page load times on cell connections.
issues.businessImpact: Slower TTFB/LCP scores lead to higher visitor abandonment.
issues.recommendation: Convert static imagery to WebP or AVIF for 30–50% payload reduction.

issues.title: Below-the-fold images missing loading="lazy"
issues.evidence: 5 images load eagerly during initial page load.
issues.userImpact: Bandwidth competition delays rendering of primary hero content.
issues.businessImpact: Degrades mobile Core Web Vitals (LCP/Speed Index).
issues.recommendation: Add loading="lazy" and decoding="async" to all non-critical images.

findings.headline: Dead CTA buttons (action keywords with # anchor)
findings.evidence: 2 buttons found with dummy href="#": "Buy / Sell", "Buy / Sell"
findings.userImpact: Visitors click primary conversion buttons and nothing happens (page jumps to top).
findings.businessImpact: Frustrated prospects bounce immediately; zero lead capture.
findings.recommendation: Attach valid destination routes or working modal event listeners to all CTA buttons.

findings.headline: External links vulnerable to reverse tabnabbing
findings.evidence: 4 external target="_blank" links lack rel="noopener noreferrer".
findings.userImpact: Opened external pages can execute window.opener.location redirection attacks.
findings.businessImpact: Reputational damage and security warning flags from enterprise browsers.
findings.recommendation: Add rel="noopener noreferrer" to all outgoing target="_blank" hyperlinks.

findings.headline: Form fields lack standard autocomplete attributes
findings.evidence: 4 input fields have no autocomplete attribute defined
findings.userImpact: Mobile and desktop users must manually type details; browser autofill cannot assist seamlessly.
findings.businessImpact: Increases form friction and abandonment rates on mobile devices.
findings.recommendation: Add standard autocomplete attributes (e.g. autocomplete="name", autocomplete="email", autocomplete="tel").

findings.headline: Missing Privacy Policy link
findings.evidence: No link containing "privacy" was detected in footer or navigation.
findings.userImpact: No disclosure on how visitor contact data is processed or stored.
findings.businessImpact: GDPR / CCPA compliance exposure; required for Google Ads approval.
findings.recommendation: Add a dedicated Privacy Policy page linked in the global footer.

findings.headline: Missing HSTS header
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Add Strict-Transport-Security with max-age=31536000 to enforce HTTPS.

findings.headline: Missing X-Frame-Options
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Set X-Frame-Options to DENY or SAMEORIGIN.

findings.headline: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Set X-Content-Type-Options to "nosniff" to prevent MIME-confusion attacks.

findings.headline: Server version exposed
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Disable or mask the Server header to prevent fingerprinting by automated scanners.

findings.headline: Framework banner exposed
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.

findings.headline: Legacy image formats used instead of WebP/AVIF
findings.evidence: 15 images served as uncompressed PNG/JPEG assets.
findings.userImpact: High mobile data consumption; sluggish page load times on cell connections.
findings.businessImpact: Slower TTFB/LCP scores lead to higher visitor abandonment.
findings.recommendation: Convert static imagery to WebP or AVIF for 30–50% payload reduction.

findings.headline: Below-the-fold images missing loading="lazy"
findings.evidence: 5 images load eagerly during initial page load.
findings.userImpact: Bandwidth competition delays rendering of primary hero content.
findings.businessImpact: Degrades mobile Core Web Vitals (LCP/Speed Index).
findings.recommendation: Add loading="lazy" and decoding="async" to all non-critical images.

findings.headline: Duplicate <h1> headings
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to one primary <h1> and use <h2>/<h3> for sub-sections.

findings.headline: Images missing alt text
findings.evidence: 2 of 34 images have no alt attribute
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text for informative images or alt="" for decorative graphics.

findings.headline: Images without explicit width/height
findings.evidence: 5 images lack width and height attributes (CLS risk)
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Include explicit width and height dimensions to prevent cumulative layout shifts.

findings.headline: Total Blocking Time (TBT) near limit
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Reduce non-critical JavaScript execution on initial route.

findings.headline: WordPress XML-RPC API publicly accessible
findings.userImpact: Impacts user experience and interaction reliability.
findings.businessImpact: Causes customer friction and potential bounce.
findings.recommendation: Disable XML-RPC via web server rules or security plugin to prevent brute-force amplification attacks.
